name: PAN-OS High-Risk Application Activity
description: Detects allowed initial traffic flows classified as application risk level 4 or 5; risk level 3 DNS traffic is excluded as high-volume background activity.
note: Created for the current Security Onion PAN-OS schema.
author: SecurityOnion
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"TRAFFIC" and panw.panos.action:allow and event.action:flow_started and panw.panos.application.risk_level:(4 or 5)

last_execution.message: This rule reached the maximum alert limit for the rule execution. Some alerts were not created.
